motion.purpose: Existing CSS live-dot helper, not proof of successful execution.

motion.name: animal-budget
motion.purpose: Persistent app-wide scene; pause and hidden tabs stop motion scheduling. DPR ≤1.5; scene and mask each near 2M backing pixels, plus four 640×480 textures; two animals below 768px, four otherwise.

motion.name: reading-mask
motion.value: 60% destination-out; 20px blur; 12px expansion; 25% core pass; 100ms invalidation delay
motion.purpose: Cached protection reduces glyph strength around measured reading regions; scroll, main resize and main DOM changes invalidate it. Paused scenes can repaint without advancing time.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Global CSS override; animal background independently keeps a still scene, stops motion scheduling and disables Play/Pause.

narrative.overview:
A restrained Operate interface for developers refining a personal agent environment through recorded evidence. The user selected Graphite, system UI typography and Linear-like keyboard primacy; Kombai Selects informs composition, not copied assets. This is an investigation workspace, not an executive dashboard.

The built interface separates persistent navigation, working evidence and optional activity. A persistent lavender ASCII animal background appears across all pages by default, with header scene controls and protected reading areas. All visuals are code-led: CSS, SVG icons, charts and an original local canvas renderer; no photographic assets or shipping rasters.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral graphite layers with muted violet selection.
Compact, sentence-case system typography and aligned evidence rows.
Keyboard-first controls with visible focus and explicit uncertainty.
App-wide ASCII animals with pausable motion and protected reading areas.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Use semantic color to distinguish recorded states, never to imply configuration causation or an invented health score.

rules.name: The Operate Type Rule
rules.body: Preserve system UI for operating the workbench; reserve text monospace for source/data, apart from decorative canvas glyphs, and never add decorative display typography.

rules.name: The Flat Evidence Rule
rules.body: Separate evidence with alignment, tone and rules; reserve elevation for dialogs and control popovers.

dos: **Do** preserve the Graphite shell, system UI typography and compact aligned evidence.
**Do** keep uncertainty, stale reads and synthetic provenance visible in words.
**Do** preserve keyboard paths, modal focus containment and visible focus.
**Do** keep animals present across all pages, with header scene controls, pausable motion and reduced-motion stills.
donts: **Don't** add navy/neon dashboard styling, promotional counters or uppercase micro-labels.
**Don't** infer instruction causation, success or agent health from trace counts or decoration.
**Don't** restrict animals to a sidebar or empty state, let unmasked glyphs compete with reading areas, or substitute photography for code-led visuals.
**Don't** treat a source-derived system record as a completed visual/accessibility review.
